title: Structure of Escherichia coli DNA gyrase with chirally wrapped DNA supports ratchet-and-pawl mechanism for an ATP-powered supercoiling motor
authors: Michalczyk E; Pabiś M; Heddle J; Ghilarov D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析大肠杆菌DNA旋转酶与DNA复合物结构，揭示ATP驱动超螺旋的棘轮-棘爪机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构机制研究，但对象非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以结构生物学为主，对TF-DNA动态互作建模有借鉴价值。
abstract: Gyrase is essential for replication and transcription in bacteria, and as such is an important target for antibiotics including fluoroquinolones. Gyrase is a molecular machine that channels the energy of ATP hydrolysis into negative supercoiling of DNA. The mechanism proposed more than 40 years ago involves stabilising and inverting a chiral DNA loop; however, the molecular basis for this is poorly understood, as the loop was never directly observed. We present high-resolution cryoEM structures of the Escherichia coli gyrase - 217 bp DNA holocomplex, and of the moxifloxacin-bound gyrase complex with cleaved 217 bp DNA. Each structure constrains an intact figure-of-eight positively supercoiled DNA loop, poised for strand passage. The loop is stabilised by a GyrA β-pinwheel domain which how we here show has a structure of a flat disc, and functions akin to a mini-nucleosome. Our data implies that during catalysis the ATPase domains of the enzyme undergo a large movement to push the transported DNA segment through the break in DNA. By comparing the catalytic site between native drug-free and moxifloxacin-bound gyrase structures that both contain a single metal ion we demonstrate that the enzyme is observed in a native pre-catalytic state. Finally, we propose a ‘ratchet and pawl’ mechanism for energy coupling in gyrase. These unexpected findings call for re-evaluation of existing data and offer a framework for further experiments designed to dissect the details of how gyrase molecular motor converts chemical energy into mechanical tension.
abstract_zh: 旋转酶（Gyrase）对于细菌的复制和转录至关重要，因此是包括氟喹诺酮类在内的抗生素的重要靶点。旋转酶是一种分子机器，将ATP水解的能量转化为DNA的负超螺旋。四十多年前提出的机制涉及稳定并反转一个手性DNA环；然而，由于该环从未被直接观察到，其分子基础至今知之甚少。我们展示了大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）旋转酶-217 bp DNA全复合物以及莫西沙星结合的旋转酶复合物与切割的217 bp DNA的高分辨率冷冻电镜结构。每个结构都约束了一个完整的八字形正超螺旋DNA环，准备进行链的通过。该环由GyrA β-针轮结构域稳定，我们在此展示该结构域具有扁平圆盘状结构，功能类似于微型核小体。我们的数据表明，在催化过程中，酶的ATP酶结构域经历大幅移动，以推动被转运的DNA片段穿过DNA断裂处。通过比较天然无药和莫西沙星结合的旋转酶结构中的催化位点（两者均含有一个金属离子），我们证明该酶处于天然的预催化状态。最后，我们提出了旋转酶中能量耦合的“棘轮与棘爪”机制。这些意外发现要求重新评估现有数据，并为旨在解析旋转酶分子马达如何将化学能转化为机械张力的进一步实验提供了框架。
